images.caption: Figure 2:A recorded research hypothesis and its planned investigation.This MIMIC-IV proposal concerns adults surviving a first ICU stay of at least 48 hours.(a)It asks whether repeated creatinine–urine output mismatch adds information about ICU readmission or in-hospital death within 48 hours after ICU discharge, during the same hospitalization.(b)B0–B2 compare clinical, current-mismatch, and repeated-mismatch logistic models; L1 adds hidden Markov model summaries, subject to data-support and stability checks. Models share a patient-level training, tuning, and test split.(c,d)Decision criteria and alternatives bound interpretation. No clinical outcome is asserted.

Figure 5:Automated hypothesis quality across self-improvement rounds.(a)Top: example research tree from each round; color shows weighted quality across eight evaluation axes. Middle: mean hypothesis quality per round. Error bars show 95% confidence intervals and shading shows the interquartile range. Bottom: mean quality per domain with 95% confidence intervals.(b)Mean and axis-specific scores. All scores are produced by the automated grader using the weights inAppendixD.
